versions.name: Knox Scout Reservation
versions.address: 1150 Fred R. Prather Parkway Lincolnton, Georgia 30817

features.note: Seven miles of shoreline on Clarks Hill/Strom Thurmond Lake.
A thirty-foot climbing wall with three routes.
A large pavilion in each of the three campground hubs.
Hot-water bath houses in each campground hub.
Knox's Own Provisional Troop for Scouts attending without their unit.
A high-adventure aquatics program on the lake.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/093-115387); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
